title: QA: price formatting regression with no safe fix
summary: A commit adds formatPercent and breaks cent padding in formatPrice; reverting the source loses the new feature (alibi-qa controlled scenario).

failingTest.name: formatPrice pads cents to two digits

expected.notes: Scripted model fixes are wrong; the deterministic revert passes the targeted test but fails the regression suite (formatPercent disappears). Every candidate is rejected.
